sections.text: Cleaned and cleared drill floor
Performed TBT for RIH with spear and retrieve 10 3/4" casing
M/u spear BHA
RIH w/ 10 3/4" spear in catch mode on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 147 m
POOH with 10 3/4" casing on 5 1/2" landing string from 147 m to surface.
Released spear at surface and r/b spear BHA
Performed TBT for r/u casing handling equipment and pulling casing.
L/d casing pup joint. Continued POOH with 10 3/4" casing from 170 m to surface. Average 10 joints/hr.
R/d handling equipment.
Performed TBT for running 13 3/8" EZSV plug
P/u and m/u EZSV plug and RT. Installed centralizer on RT. L/d double 5 1/2" DP. P/u and m/u 3 pup joints for space out
RIH w/ 13 3/8" EZSV plug from 24 m to 306 m.
P/u and m/u pump-in sub.
M/u TDS and washed setting area with 560 LPM 6 bar. Set 13 3/8" EZSV plug at 306m. Tagged EZSV plug with 10 ton.

Pumped 10 m3 wash pill followed by 10 m3 hi-vis pill at 2000 LPM 9 bar. Circulated with clean SW until clean returns. Reduced to 900 LPM when hi-vis at shakers. Increased flow to 2440 LPM when clean SW in returns. Meanwhile flushed tts.
Performed TBT for cement job

Closed flow line and opened dump line. R/u cement hose to pump-in sub. Applied 20 bar behind FOSV and confirmed line-up. Leak tested surface lines to 100 bar 3min. Balanced oh to surface cement plug in 13 3/8" casing m 205 m pumped 10 m3 DW at 1000 LPM with cement unit. Mixed and pumped 7,8 m3 1,95sg cement slurry at 600 LPM. Displaced cement with 2 m3 DW at 1000 LPM with cement unit.
R/d cement hose. B/o and l/o pump-in sub.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 305 m to 160 m.
Installed 2x sponge balls. Circulated bu, 2000 LPM.
POOH w/ EZSV RT on 5 1/2" DP from 160 m to 80 m. M/u BOP jetting tool and FOSV.
Jetted BOP 8 x passes up/down, 1450 LPM, 50 RPM. Operated annular preventer and pipe rams. B/o and l/o BOP jetting tool and FOSV.
Removed PS-21 slips and installed master bushing.
POOH and l/d the EZSV RT.
RIH with 3 STD 8 1/4" DC. L/o 2 x singles to cantilever.
Performed TBT with ongoing crew. Performed manual tong training. L/o 7 joints 8 1/4" DC.
L/o 10 3/4" spear BHA
L/o 3 joints 6 3/4" DC
L/o 5 joints over-torqued 5 1/2" DP
